title: steris nivalis
intro: Steris nivalis, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Northern Europe, Eastern North America, and parts of Asia, with white, bell-shaped flowers and red berries. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and diarrhea due to its astringent and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Steris nivalis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and promote kidney health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, salicin, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
